description: Replaces an exact string in a file with a new string. The old string must be unique in the file unless replace_all is true, so include enough surrounding context to identify the one occurrence you mean. Read the file first.

path.description: The absolute path of the file to modify

new_string.description: The text to replace it with (must be different from old_string)

replace_all.description: Replace all occurrences of old_string (default false)
